data: Authored synthetic fixtures, 240 evaluation records: 120 known structure + 120 renamed-field structure
baseline: Same parsers and validators, fixed aliases, rejects missing required fields; no mapping review/replay

raw_integrity.scope: Local byte integrity, not proof of origin or tamper-proof storage

microbenchmark.storage: SQLite in memory; durable disk I/O excluded

limits: The comparison includes an operator-supplied mapping; the baseline can recover too if edited and replayed
